items.title: Employment ends
items.quote: Wir kündigen deshalb das Arbeitsverhältnis ordentlich unter Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Frist zum 31.01.2027.
items.computation: The letter states the termination date explicitly as 31.01.2027; no calculation needed.

items.title: Register as job-seeking (arbeitsuchend) with the Agentur für Arbeit
items.quote: Um Nachteile beim Arbeitslosengeld zu vermeiden, müssen Sie sich sofort bei der Agentur für Arbeit arbeitsuchend melden.
items.computation: The notice was handed over and thus received on 18.11.2026, for a termination effective 31.01.2027 — about 10 weeks' notice, less than the 3-month advance notice required by §38 Abs. 1 Satz 1 SGB III. Where less than 3 months' notice is given, §38 Abs. 1 Satz 2 SGB III requires registering as arbeitsuchend within 3 days of learning the end date. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt (18.11.2026) is not counted, so the 3-day period runs 19.11.→21.11.2026 (Saturday). Because the act is owed to an authority, §193 BGB shifts a deadline falling on a Saturday to the next business day: Monday 23.11.2026 (skipping Sunday 22.11.2026).

items.title: File Kündigungsschutzklage (unfair-dismissal claim) with the Arbeitsgericht
items.quote: Zu Ihrer Information: Eine Klage gegen diese Kündigung wäre innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Erhalt des Schreibens beim Arbeitsgericht einzureichen.
items.computation: Per §4 KSchG the 3-week period to file a Kündigungsschutzklage runs from receipt of the written notice. The letter was handed over in person on 18.11.2026 in the presence of a witness, so that is the day of receipt. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt is not counted; counting starts 19.11.2026. Under §188 Abs. 2 BGB a period stated in weeks ends on the day bearing the same name as the starting day: 3 weeks after Wednesday 18.11.2026 is Wednesday 09.12.2026, which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so no shift applies.

warnings: The 3-day deadline to register as arbeitsuchend with the Agentur für Arbeit (around 23.11.2026) has likely already passed as of today (24.11.2026, three days after receipt on 18.11.2026); register immediately in any case, since the obligation continues and delay can reduce unemployment benefit (§159 SGB III).
The 3-week deadline to file a Kündigungsschutzklage is short and already running (ends 09.12.2026); if the dismissal is to be contested, legal advice should be sought without delay.
